card.name: Words right before the word dose
card.fires_on: Small words like the, a, recommended, prior or maintenance that sit just before the word dose or dosage in dosing instructions. The pole responds to the word before dose, not to dose itself.

modes.label: Article before dose
modes.description: The word the or a after a verb such as reduce or increase, or after at, right before dose or dosage.
modes.example: Intervention Consider increasing<< the>> TRINTELLIX dose when a

modes.label: Adjective before dose
modes.description: Words like recommended, usual, prior or maintenance that come right before dose.
modes.example: Decrease guanfacine extended-release tablets dosage to half the<< recommended>> level.

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict the singular word value (and its variants) next and to avoid the plural values.
card.plain: It marks the spot in a dosing sentence where a single dose word is about to come next.
